title: One Clean Cut
note: One Grow: take their tile, and one more is cut off with it.

title: Take, Then Blast
note: Take their tile with a Grow first, then Blast.

title: Small Cards
note: Bloom the 1s first, then Grow onto their tile: one more is cut off.

title: Short Fuse
note: Grow first, then Blast: three of their tiles are cut off.

title: Three Twos
note: Bloom the three 2s, then Grow the 6 onto their tile.

title: Clear the Way
note: The Bomb goes first; then the 1s Bloom.

title: Fives
note: Take their tile with the 4, then Bloom the 5s: five tiles are cut off.

title: Nine, Then Blast
note: Grow the 9 onto their tile, then Blast.

title: High Fives
note: Bloom the three 5s, then Grow the 6 onto their tile.

title: Bomb First
note: The Bomb goes first; the 4s Bloom then takes two tiles and cuts one off.

title: The Long Root
note: Bloom the 3s, then the 9 takes their tile and cuts three off.

title: Two Moves
note: Grow the 9 onto their tile, then Blast: one more is cut off.

title: Threes Over
note: Bloom the 3s over their tile, then Grow the 5: one more is cut off.

title: Five Fall
note: Bloom the 1s, then the Bomb cuts five tiles off.

title: Grow Before Bloom
note: This time the Grow comes first: the 7 takes their tile, then the 2s Bloom.

title: Triple Three
note: The 3s Bloom takes two tiles and cuts one off; the 5 takes another.

title: Sixes and a Bomb
note: The 6s Bloom takes three tiles; the Bomb then cuts three off.

title: The Needle
note: Out of thousands of turns, only this one: Bloom the 2s, then the 9 takes their tile.

title: Landslide
note: The 5s Bloom takes three tiles; the 6 takes one more and cuts one off.

title: Run It
note: Bomb first, then the 4-5-6 run Blooms over two tiles: three are cut off.

title: Home Closed
note: Blast, Bloom the 1-2-3 run, and the last Grow closes their home.

title: Early Pressure
note: Bloom the 3s over their tile, then the 6 takes another.

title: Sevens
note: The 7s Bloom takes three tiles and cuts one off; the Bomb cuts two more.

title: Run and Root
note: Bloom the 4-5-6 run over two tiles, then the 9 takes one and cuts two off.

title: Double Cut
note: The 5s Bloom cuts two off, and the 8 cuts two more.

title: Set Up the Blast
note: Grow the 5 onto their tile first; then the Blast cuts two off.

title: Everything at Once
note: Grow the 8 onto their tile, Blast to cut three off, then Bloom the 2s.

title: Seven Down
note: Bloom the 1s, then one Grow of the 9 cuts seven tiles off.

title: Two Blooms
note: Two Blooms in one turn: the 3s cut three off, then the 1s, then the 9.

title: The Big One
note: The 9 takes their tile, the Blast cuts eleven off, and the 1-2-3 run Blooms.
